targets.expr: (max by(instance) (ssas_collector_errors{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) and on(instance) ((max by(instance) (ssas_up{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) == 0 or (max by(instance) (ssas_collector_errors{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) > 0 or (max by(instance) (ssas_service_running{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) == 0)

(max by(instance) (ssas_service_running{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) and on(instance) ((max by(instance) (ssas_up{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) == 0 or (max by(instance) (ssas_collector_errors{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) > 0 or (max by(instance) (ssas_service_running{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) == 0)

(max by(instance) (ssas_processing_failures_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) and on(instance) ((max by(instance) (ssas_up{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) == 0 or (max by(instance) (ssas_collector_errors{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) > 0 or (max by(instance) (ssas_service_running{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) == 0)
